title: Cesarean delivery rate by state (%, 2023)

source.name: National Vital Statistics Reports -- state natality tables
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: 2023 state cesarean rates from NCHS natality data: Mississippi highest at 37.9%, Alaska lowest at 24.0%. This pattern (Southern states clustering high, Mountain West/Alaska clustering low) has held for nearly two decades and reflects hospital practice variation more than patient risk.
